signals.text: 2.23 Creative use of space and carefully researched and chosen resources include a sensory room, platform staging and information and communication technology (ICT) hub, together with specialist art and music teaching.
Music and drama are embedded across the school, with every pupil having the opportunity to perform, such as in the Christmas concert.
Leaders have crafted a diverse programme of extra-curricular activities, and participation levels are high.

areas.summary: Strong publicly visible evidence for ethos and values (5 specific items). Listed provision includes british values, respect, christian, catholic, ethos.

signals.text: PART 2 – Spiritual, moral, social and cultural development of pupils 2.5 Principles and values are actively promoted which facilitate the personal development of pupils as responsible, tolerant, law-abiding citizens.

These are the regulations on safeguarding; measures to guard against bullying; arrangements for pupils’ health and safety, arrangements to check the suitability of staff; the provision of information to parents; the handling of parents’ complaints; and other related aspects of leadership and management.
Children develop a good understanding of modern British values, with particular regard to democracy and mutual respect.
The sc hool is Christian with a Catholic foundation, welcoming pupils of all faiths and none.
The proprietor ensures that leaders demonstrate good knowledge and skills and promote a robust safeguarding ethos in the school.
